messages:
ben: Heads-up: scheduling v2 rollout tonight during maintenance window 23:45-01:15 UTC. Plan: canary -> 20% -> 50% over ~40m. Feature gate: header-negotiation (opt-in). No schema bumps. Please surface any client pin hotspots before T-2h.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: roll-2024-11-10-v2. Canary to 20% in 10m, then to 50% over 30m. throttle-on-warn=true. Telemetry stream: https://telemetry.internal/v2/roll-2024-11-10-v2

alice: Quick question for docs: do we need a compatibility blurb about header case normalization? I can add a short note but want exact language.

ben: Keep it brief: "v2 supports optional header negotiation. If your client sets X-API-Version: v1, we'll respect it. For best results enable case-insensitive header parsing. Automatic fallback to v1 for 12h if any negotiation failures detected."

jamie: What are the concrete canary abort/slow criteria so oncall knows when to pause vs rollback?

ben: Canary rules:
- Pause progression (do not increase % for next step) if error_rate(v2) > error_rate(v1) + 0.4% for 3m AND trend is increasing
- Auto-slow (throttle) if 5m error delta is between 0.15%-0.4% -> notify #oncall and hold progression for 10m
- Full rollback if error_rate(v2) > error_rate(v1) + 1.0% for 3m OR p95 latency regresses >50% for 5m
Manual rollback: 
```
deployctl rollback --id roll-2024-11-10-v2 --reason "canary-abort"
```

tilly: SDK-wise: tenants with explicit header pin to v1 should continue to be routed to v1. we should not flip active connections. Confirm sticky behavior?

ben: Confirmed. Active sessions pinned to v1 will remain for 48h unless tenant unpins. Add note to handoff doc.

chun: Can deploy-bot emit an automatic slowdown instead of immediate rollback when metrics are marginal? prefer to give app teams time to triage.

ben: Yes - setting throttle-on-warn to true. It will reduce progression increments to +5% steps and send an incident ping to #oncall. If the throttled state persists >20m, ops should escalate.

sdk-team-bot: SDK teams notified: will append doc snippet about header negotiation and casefold suggestion. Link to PR: https://git.internal/sdk/PR-889

alice: I'll prep the release note line: "Server: v2 header negotiation (opt-in). Backwards fallback to v1 for 12h on negotiation errors. Recommend clients handle header case-insensitively." Anything else to call out?

ben: Call out operator notes: deploy ID, progression thresholds, telemetry dashboards, rollback command, and tenant pin behavior. Handoff in #releases-handoff at 23:40 UTC.

jamie: I'll post dashboard links + alert queries 15m before handoff. Will include p50/p95, error_rate, client_pin_ratio, and client-heartbeat-failures.

ben: One last ask: if client_pin_ratio for v1 >2% of traffic, pause the rollout and coordinate with account teams before continuing.

tilly: ack. will warn account-eng if we hit that.

deploy-bot: roll-2024-11-10-v2 configured: canary=20%, second-stage=50%, throttle-on-warn=true, telemetry_prefix=v2.roll. Metrics will be visible in telemetry.prod. Quarantine behavior: disabled (we rely on throttle-on-warn for graceful stop).

jamie: ack. I'll be on hand for the handoff and first 30m of the canary.

alice: release notes + SDK blurb pushed. PR: https://git.internal/docs/PR-2345

ben: Thanks team. If anything looks off during canary, shout immediately and we will either throttle or rollback. :thumbsup:
